connector.name: Boxkite - Xero Backup & Export
connector.registryDescription: Complete read-only backup and export of Xero accounting data as a ZIP plus a manifest.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.getboxkite.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.getboxkite, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Optional. The server supports OAuth, so most clients need no key: connect and you will be sent to Boxkite to sign in and approve access. Supply a key here only if your client cannot do OAuth. Keys come from app.getboxkite.com/settings/api-keys; send the raw key with no prefix.
